cls.quote: The Performance Line CX system includes a handlebar-mounted Bosch MiniRemote to shift through the various levels of pedal assist. It also includes the top tube integrated Bosch System Controller display to monitor battery levels and pedal assist mode. Curiously, we couldn’t find the Muga’s e-bike classification or top speed listed anywhere on the brand’s website or in the press materials, but it’s fair to assume that it will comply with regional regulations and standards. ⟶ A look inside the Muga frame.

wh.quote: Between the three complete Muga builds currently offered, riders have the option to choose either a longer-range 750 Wh battery (Muga 10 and 20) or a lighter-weight 600 Wh battery (Muga 30).
